{"_meta":{"io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo":{"description":"Context7 provides up-to-date documentation and code examples for libraries and frameworks.","icons":[{"mimeType":"image/svg+xml","sizes":["any"],"src":"https://context7.com/context7-icon-green.svg"},{"mimeType":"image/png","sizes":["512x512"],"src":"https://context7.com/context7-icon-green.png"}],"name":"Context7","title":"Context7","version":"4.4.2","websiteUrl":"https://context7.com"}},"content":[{"text":"### PortExecution.tradingPorts — weighted destination selection with isFriendly\n\nSource: https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/blob/main/packages/engine/src/execution/PortExecution.ts\n\nBuilds a probability-weighted list of destination ports: each candidate appears once per level, again if in the proximity bonus group (nearest few ports), and again if the owner is friendly (isFriendly). The uniform random pick from this list naturally biases toward higher-level, closer, allied ports.\n\n```typescript\n  // It's a probability list, so if an element appears twice it's because it's\n  // twice more likely to be picked later.\n  tradingPorts(): Unit[] {\n    const sourceComponents = new Set<number>();\n    for (const neighbor of this.mg.neighbors(this.port!.tile())) {\n      if (!this.mg.isWater(neighbor)) continue;\n      const comp = this.mg.getWaterComponent(neighbor);\n      if (comp !== null) sourceComponents.add(comp);\n    }\n    const ports = this.mg\n      .players()\n      .filter((p) => p !== this.port!.owner() && p.canTrade(this.port!.owner()))\n      .flatMap((p) => p.units(UnitType.Port))\n      .filter((p) => {\n        for (const comp of sourceComponents) {\n          if (this.mg.hasWaterComponent(p.tile(), comp)) return true;\n        }\n        return false;\n      })\n      .sort((p1, p2) => {\n        return (\n          this.mg.manhattanDist(this.port!.tile(), p1.tile()) -\n          this.mg.manhattanDist(this.port!.tile(), p2.tile())\n        );\n      });\n\n    const weightedPorts: Unit[] = [];\n\n    for (const [i, otherPort] of ports.entries()) {\n      const expanded = new Array(otherPort.level()).fill(otherPort);\n      weightedPorts.push(...expanded);\n      const tooClose =\n        this.mg.manhattanDist(this.port!.tile(), otherPort.tile()) <\n        this.mg.config().tradeShipShortRangeDebuff();\n      const closeBonus =\n        i < this.mg.config().proximityBonusPortsNb(ports.length);\n      if (!tooClose && closeBonus) {\n        weightedPorts.push(...expanded);\n      }\n      if (!tooClose && this.port!.owner().isFriendly(otherPort.owner())) {\n        weightedPorts.push(...expanded);\n      }\n    }\n    return weightedPorts;\n  }\n```\n\n--------------------------------\n\n### AllianceImpl expiry — construction, expiry check, and extension\n\nSource: https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/blob/main/packages/engine/src/game/AllianceImpl.ts\n\nAlliance stores an expiresAt tick, set at creation from config.allianceDuration(). Each tick PlayerExecution checks all alliances and expires those past their deadline. extend() resets expiresAt.\n\n```typescript\n  constructor(\n    private mg: Game,\n    public requestor_: Player,\n    public recipient_: Player,\n    private createdAt_: Tick,\n    private id_: number,\n  ) {\n    this.expiresAt_ = createdAt_ + mg.config().allianceDuration();\n  }\n  ...\n  expire(): void {\n    this.mg.expireAlliance(this);\n  }\n  extend(): void {\n    this.extensionRequestedRequestor_ = false;\n    this.extensionRequestedRecipient_ = false;\n    this.expiresAt_ = this.mg.ticks() + this.mg.config().allianceDuration();\n  }\n  expiresAt(): Tick {\n    return this.expiresAt_;\n  }\n```","type":"text"}],"isError":false}
